scope: Real Chromium DOM and XLSX downloads with simulated shop pages and Chrome API mocks; not live-store verification.
checks: Dashboard initializes with zero real rows, disabled export, and the user-provided store URL.
Start/pause/resume controls send correct commands and follow returned state.
Manual item-link import sends the link and refreshes queue state.
Storage updates render SKU rows; unknown prices, zero stock, search, price filters and source details work.
Browser download opens as a three-sheet XLSX; all rows exported despite filters, long IDs/blank price/zero stock preserved.
Retry, open collection tab and help controls are wired and functional.
Untrusted title and javascript URL are displayed safely without executable HTML or links.
Dashboard fits a 780 px viewport; table remains horizontally scrollable.
Real shop fixture DOM extracts product lists, excludes recommendations, detects next/disabled-last-page and deduplicates overlap.
Real product fixture DOM parses ICE context and SKU-specific prices without applying item minimum to each SKU.
Verification challenge DOM is detected for manual handling.

native_extension.note: No extension service worker appeared within 6 seconds. Managed Chromium policy blocks all non-allowlisted extensions.
